text_block_list.text:
A few weeks before the Spring Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"—Alright then, for the Thanksgiving 
Festival, our class will also be setting 
up a 'Photo Spot'!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"I know you're busy with solo 
competitions, but... Within what you can 
manage! Let's do our best for the fans!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako! Make the pom-poms! The Norizu crew 
goes all-out and flashy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa, my liege~ You need to get your 
hands moving too~

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa... I messed up again...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, setting up a corner to take photos 
with autographs... Does anyone actually 
take photos with signatures...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Apparently so. Besides, displaying 
autographs and comments seems to be quite 
popular in many other circles as well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if you're struggling to write 
it, why not ask for a few tips?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "...I asked Tanino Gimlet-san about it."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, I can write it more 
neatly now... just like a proper 
autograph."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Unnecessary. Keep your focus on 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If it's me, I'm gonna write the coolest 
autograph ever! Of course I can nail it! 
—HRAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: —All dooooone!!

And then came the day of the Spring Fan 
Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
All right, strike a pose! ...What a great 
photo~♪

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, all of these 'photo spots' are 
super cute! Even the castle made of 
pom-poms looks great!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"The autograph session at the end was so 
great too~! Furioso's autograph was super 
cool~."

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know, right? That was so cool~! The 
way it was broken down made it look like a 
piece of art! It was unexpected, but... 
it's like a whole new kind of charm.

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
—Espoir City's autograph was so totally 
like her, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Heavy pen pressure, as if unused to 
writing... Hehe. It had character... and I 
really liked that.

The night of the Fan Appreciation 
Festival. The Umamusume gather around the 
campfire, praising each other for their 
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And Espoir City...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Let's get started, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Not taking a break again today, huh?

You're not taking a break again today, are 
you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!? You're the one who told me to! To 
beat all the record times!"

Preparing for the decisive battle against 
Furioso in the Kashiwa Kinen, she 
continues her special training, aiming to 
beat her records across all distances.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I can do it, got it? I'm not some wimp 
who's gonna whine and give up halfway 
through.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna see it all through to the 
end.
choice_data_list:
While running, stay conscious of the 
position of your shoulder blades.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I am!
choice_data_list:
Push harder. ...Because I know you can do 
it.

Push harder. ...Because I know you have it 
in you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Time me again. Make it 1,600 meters 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!

Espoir City dug her legs into the sand, 
kicking up dust.

With an acceleration that reaches top 
speed in the blink of an eye... evolving 
her instantaneous sharpness along the way.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahーー!!

The sheer tenacity burned into her heart 
cuts straight through the night air.

The sheer tenacity burned into her heart 
cuts straight through the night air.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Aaaaargh! Dammit allllll!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: One more time!!

She refuses to allow herself to whine and 
give up.
choice_data_list:
Let's take a break, then try one more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: O-Oof!!

And while getting things ready for next, 
...my eyes suddenly fall upon the knot of 
her shoelaces.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What's your deal, bastard?
choice_data_list:
...The knot on your shoe is twisted 
inward.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...It's not solved at all, dammit!
choice_data_list:
Still, that kind of uncoolness doesn't 
suit you at all.
But it's a bad look that doesn't suit you

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
All this over something so damn trivial... 
Seriously annoying... Geez...

Contrary to her words, her hand reached 
toward her shoelaces.

Smoothly, smoothly... Lacing it back up 
from two eyelets back... And tying the 
knot tight and firm.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Talk about cool.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —I bet.
And she began running once more.

Espoir City continues to surpass the 
Espoir City of the past.
